newsitem.title: USA: Reuter Manufacturing Q4 net climbs.
newsitem.headline: Reuter Manufacturing Q4 net climbs.

text.p: Reuter Manufacturing Inc said Friday improved margins helped the company post a profit in the fourth quarter ended December 31 compared to a loss one year ago, when results were affected by a restructuring of debt and a loss from discontinued operations.
The company reported net income of $350,921, or $0.10 a share, versus a loss of $781,451, or $0.24 a share last year. Sales were $4.1 million, up from $2.3 million in 1995, the company said.
Reuter Manufacturing added the latest earnings did not meet higher expectations because of a temporary schedule reduction by one of its major customers.
The company makes medical products and precision parts.
